finding.title: Retries and the failed state disagree
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a service that marks the charge failed after the first failed capture, because `After the third failed attempt the charge moves to state failed` (S:10) is read next to `The service retries a failed capture up to 3 times, with 10 minutes between attempts.` (S:9), and the charge is wrong because the retries never run.

e1.text: After the third failed attempt the charge moves to state failed
e1.context:
R1. A charge is created in state pending and moves to captured only after the card network confirms the authorization.
R2. A captured charge is never modified; a correction is made by a new refund entry.
R3. The service retries a failed capture up to 3 times, with 10 minutes between attempts.
R4. After the third failed attempt the charge moves to state failed and the customer is notified by email.

## 3. Refunds
R5. A refund may be issued for any captured charge within 90 days of the capture date.
